name: Capgo
description: Ships live over-the-air updates and native builds for Capacitor apps, with a hosted MCP server for managing channels, bundles and rollouts from chat.

skills.name: Manage Apps and Bundles
skills.description: Lists your Capgo apps and uploaded bundles and moves a release channel to a new bundle from an AI assistant.

skills.name: Control Rollouts
skills.description: Pauses a progressive rollout or checks update health for a channel before more devices receive the release.

skills.name: Read Native Build Logs
skills.description: Reads iOS and Android native build logs from Capgo Builder so the assistant can diagnose failing builds.
